events.title: The mobile demo is now simultaneously available
events.summary: To our dear readers: Our game has now launched a trial version of its mobile game on TapTap.This mobile test only includes adaptation for a selection of devices. We will continue to optimize the mobile control logic and improve device compatibility and content in future updates.
